title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. Although prior work reports near-perfect in-distribution (IND) distillation performance, we find that this can mask incomplete capability consolidation beyond the supervised distribution. A preliminary study on synthetic reasoning shows that OPD does not fully transfer teachers' generalization capabilities. We then extend this investigation to real-world tasks, evaluating extrapolative and compositional generalization across mathematical reasoning, coding, agent, and long-context capabilities using Qwen3 models. Across extrapolative settings, OPD and MOPD reach 96.04-102.73% of their teachers' IND scores. Yet their out-of-distribution (OOD) scores remain 2.45-16.25% below the base model's. translated_title: 论在线策略蒸馏在强化学习后能力巩固中的泛化局限性
translated_abstract: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将在线策略蒸馏（OPD）扩展为从多个教师模型中巩固能力。尽管先前的工作报告了近乎完美的分布内（IND）蒸馏性能，我们发现这可能掩盖了监督分布之外能力巩固不完全的问题。一项针对合成推理的初步研究表明，OPD 无法完全迁移教师模型的泛化能力。随后，我们将这一研究扩展到真实世界任务，使用 Qwen3 模型在数学推理、编程、智能体和长上下文能力方面评估了外推泛化与组合泛化。在外推设置中，OPD 和 MOPD 达到了其教师模型 IND 分数的 96.04%–102.73%，但其分布外（OOD）分数仍比基础模型低 2.45%–16.25%。在三个组合设置中，MOPD 在分布内性能上优于基础模型，但其在组合任务上的表现（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD/MOPD）虽能近乎完美地复现教师模型的分布内性能，但无法完全迁移其泛化能力，分布外表现甚至低于基础模型，揭示了该方法在强化学习后能力巩固中的泛化局限。
en_tdlr: On-policy distillation (OPD/MOPD) achieves near-perfect in-distribution performance but fails to fully transfer teachers' generalization capabilities, with out-of-distribution performance even falling below the base model, revealing its generalization limitation in post-RL consolidation.
